roles.create.description: Create a role on the current side (platform or tenant); the code is unique per side and cannot be changed. Requires access.roles.create.
roles.get.description: Get a role with its granted permissions and member count. Requires access.roles.read.
roles.list.description: List roles of the current side with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires access.roles.read.
roles.update.description: Update a role's name, description, order and status. Requires access.roles.update.
roles.delete.description: Delete roles in batch together with their members and permissions; built-in roles cannot be deleted. Requires access.roles.delete.
roles.grant.description: Grant permissions to a role; codes must exist in the catalog and match the role's side. Requires access.roles.grant.
roles.revoke.description: Revoke permissions from a role. Requires access.roles.grant.
roles.assign.description: Assign users to a role; users must belong to the role's side. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
roles.unassign.description: Remove users from a role. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
roles.members.description: List the members of a role. Requires access.roles.read.
permissions.list.description: List the grantable permission catalog: the caller's side by default; platform principals may pass side=tenant for the tenant side (used to edit edition whitelists); for tenant principals the catalog is narrowed by their edition. Requires access.permissions.read.
auth.permissions.description: Return the current principal's effective permissions, roles, menu tree and page codes.
access.role.code_taken: Role code '{code}' is already taken on this side.
access.role.built_in: Role '{code}' is built in and cannot be deleted.
access.permission.unknown: Permission '{code}' is not in the catalog.
access.permission.scope_mismatch: Permission '{code}' cannot be granted on the {side} side.
access.member.not_found: User '{id}' does not exist or does not belong to the role's side.
roles.by_user.description: List the roles a user holds on the current side (platform or tenant). Requires access.roles.read.
access.role.data_scope_not_applicable: Platform role '{code}' can only have the data scope 'All' and no custom departments.
access.role.custom_scope_empty: Role '{code}' uses a custom data scope but lists no department.
access.department.not_found: Department '{id}' does not exist in this tenant.
access.permission.side_denied: Tenant principals can only view the tenant-side permission catalog.
menus.list.description: List the whole menu tree (hidden nodes, operator-created directories and links, and the customization flag of page nodes). Platform side only; requires access.menus.read.
menus.get.description: Get one menu node. Requires access.menus.read.
menus.create.description: Create an operator node: a directory (top level only) or an external link (http / https, may sit in a directory); page nodes come from page registrations and cannot be created. Requires access.menus.create.
menus.update.description: Update a menu node: page nodes only change presentation (title, icon, order, directory, visibility, caching, pinned tab) and become customized; operator nodes may also change their link and permission. Requires access.menus.update.
menus.reset.description: Restore a page node's presentation to its registration and clear the customization flag. Requires access.menus.update.
menus.delete.description: Delete operator nodes in batch; page nodes and directories that still have children are rejected item by item. Requires access.menus.delete.
access.menu.built_in: Menu '{code}' comes from a page registration and cannot be deleted; hide it instead.
access.menu.has_children: Directory '{code}' still contains menus and cannot be deleted.
access.menu.parent_invalid: Invalid parent: directories stay at the top level, links and top-level pages may only sit in a directory, and child pages cannot leave their registered parent.
access.menu.url_invalid: An external link must be an absolute http or https address; directories cannot have one.
access.menu.page_managed: Page menus come from page registrations: they cannot be created, and their route, component, permission and link cannot be changed.
access.menu.title_required: Directories and links need a title.
access.menu.not_page: '{code}' is not a page menu and has no defaults to restore.
access.menu.platform_only: Menus can only be managed on the platform side.
roles.deny.description: Deny permissions on a role: revokes the same grants and writes Deny rules (optional validity window and reason); a role deny only removes that role's own grants. Requires access.roles.grant.
roles.update_member.description: Change the validity window of a member assignment; expired or future assignments are dropped from decisions at once. Requires access.roles.assign.
user_grants.list.description: List the permissions granted or denied directly to a user on the current side, with windows and reasons. Requires access.user-grants.read.
user_grants.grant.description: Grant permissions directly to a user (optional validity window and reason). Requires access.user-grants.grant.
user_grants.deny.description: Deny permissions directly on a user; a user deny overrides every grant. Requires access.user-grants.grant.
user_grants.revoke.description: Revoke direct grants or denies of a user. Requires access.user-grants.grant.
user_data_scopes.get.description: Read a user's data scope override (tenant side only); without one the roles decide. Requires access.user-data-scopes.read.
user_data_scopes.set.description: Set or clear a user's data scope override (tenant side only); the override replaces the roles' scopes entirely. Requires access.user-data-scopes.update.
access.grant.window_invalid: Invalid validity window: the expiry ({expiresAt}) must be later than the start ({effectiveAt}).
access.user_data_scope.tenant_only: User data scopes are set on the tenant side only.
access.user_data_scope.departments: A custom data scope must list departments; other scopes must not.
field_security.entities.description: List the entities and fields that field security can protect (registered by each package). Requires access.field-security.read.
field_security.list.description: List the field security rules of the current side with paging. Requires access.field-security.read.
field_security.get.description: Get a field security rule. Requires access.field-security.read.
field_security.create.description: Create a field security rule: how a role, user or department reads a field and whether it may change it. Requires access.field-security.create.
field_security.update.description: Edit a field security rule, including enabling and disabling it. Requires access.field-security.update.
field_security.delete.description: Delete field security rules. Requires access.field-security.delete.
access.field_security.not_found: Field security rule {id} does not exist.
access.field_security.taken: This target already has a rule on {entity}.{field}; edit that one instead.
access.field_security.entity_unknown: Entity {entity} does not support field security.
access.field_security.strategy_not_appli: Field {field} cannot use the {strategy} strategy: non-text fields can only be shown read-only or hidden, and non-nullable fields cannot be hidden.
access.field_security.no_effect: A plain, editable rule restricts nothing; choose a mask or make it read-only.
access.field_security.keep_invalid: Partial masking must keep 0 to {max} characters at each end, and not zero at both (that is the same as a full mask).
access.field_security.replacement_invali: The fixed-text strategy needs a text of at most {max} characters.
access.field_security.target_tenant_only: Department targets are configured on the tenant side only.
access.field_security.target_disabled: Target {kind} {id} is disabled and cannot get field security rules.
roles.hierarchy.description: Get the inheritance of a role: all its parents, all its children, and the grants and denials it inherits. Requires access.roles.read.
roles.set_parents.description: Set the direct parents of a role to the given set (empty removes all inheritance): its holders get the parents' grants right away, and the parents' denials apply to it too. Requires access.roles.set-parents.
delegations.list.description: List the delegations of the current side with paging; their status follows from revocation and the validity window. Requires access.delegations.read.
delegations.create.description: Create a delegation: the delegator hands one permission or one role to the delegatee for a limited time, and must hold it now. Requires access.delegations.create.
delegations.revoke.description: Revoke a pending or active delegation, keeping the record. Requires access.delegations.revoke.
delegations.delete.description: Delete delegation records; an active one stops taking effect. Requires access.delegations.delete.
access.role.self_parent: A role cannot inherit from itself.
access.role.inheritance_built_in: Built-in role {name} does not take part in inheritance.
access.role.parent_disabled: Disabled role {name} cannot be set as a parent.
access.role.inheritance_cycle: {name} already inherits from this role; making it a parent would form a cycle.
access.role.inheritance_redundant: This role already inherits {name} through another parent; there is no need to inherit it directly.
access.role.has_children: Role {name} is still inherited by other roles; remove that inheritance before deleting it.
access.delegation.self: The delegator and the delegatee cannot be the same user.
access.delegation.target_invalid: A delegation must name exactly one permission or one role.
access.delegation.window_invalid: The delegation must expire later than now and later than its start.
access.delegation.delegator_not_holding: The delegator does not hold {target} now and cannot delegate it.
access.delegation.role_invalid: Role {name} is disabled or built in and cannot be delegated.
access.delegation.taken: An identical delegation is already pending or active; revoke that one first.
access.delegation.closed: Delegation {id} has already been revoked or has expired.
permission_conditions.attributes.descrip: List the condition attribute catalog (shared by permission conditions and access policies), with the operators each allows and whether it is known before authentication. Requires access.permission-conditions.read.
permission_conditions.list.description: List the grant bindings of a role or user and the condition clauses on them. Requires access.permission-conditions.read.
permission_conditions.create.description: Add a condition clause to a grant or denial: met to grant on a grant, met to deny on a denial. Requires access.permission-conditions.create.
permission_conditions.update.description: Edit a condition clause, including enabling and disabling it. Requires access.permission-conditions.update.
access.condition.binding_missing: The subject has no {action} on {permission} to put a condition on.
access.condition.subject_invalid: Role {name} is disabled or built in and cannot carry conditions.
access.condition.groups_exceeded: A grant can have at most {max} condition groups.
access.condition.clauses_exceeded: A condition group can have at most {max} conditions.
access.condition.not_met: This operation is not allowed under the current conditions.
permission_conditions.trial.description: Condition trial: decide one permission for one user under the given request, explained group by group and clause by clause. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.
permission_conditions.batch_trial.descri: Impact trial: the current verdict for everyone a grant affects, up to 200 people. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.
permission_conditions.inventory.descript: Condition inventory: diagnostics for every condition on the current side and the conclusion of its group. Requires access.permission-conditions.trial.
access.policy.code_invalid: An access policy code must not be empty or contain whitespace: {code}
access.policy.conditions_required: An access policy needs at least one condition.
access.policy.conditions_exceeded: An access policy can have at most {maxGroups} condition groups and {maxConditions} conditions.
access.policy.window_invalid: The expiry time must be later than the effective time.
access.policy.self_lockout: Access policy {code} would block this very request, so it was not saved. Adjust the conditions first, or keep it log only and confirm with a trial.
access.policy.template_unknown: Access policy template {code} does not exist.
access.policy.denied: Access was denied by a security policy.
policies.list.description: List the access policies of the current side, by evaluation order by default. Requires access.policies.read.
policies.get.description: Get an access policy by ID. Requires access.policies.read.
policies.create.description: Create an access policy; it always starts as log only and enabled. Requires access.policies.create.
policies.update.description: Replace the content and conditions of an access policy; its action and status stay. Requires access.policies.update.
policies.set_action.description: Change the action of an access policy: log only, deny or allow. Requires access.policies.update.
policies.set_status.description: Enable or disable an access policy. Requires access.policies.update.
policies.templates.description: List the preset access policy templates. Requires access.policies.read.
policies.trial.description: Trial an access policy: evaluate a saved policy or draft conditions under the given request, explained group by group and condition by condition. Requires access.policies.trial.
policies.attributes.description: The condition attributes available to access policies, with the operators each allows and whether it is known before authentication. Requires access.policies.read.
access.policy.login_denied: Sign-in is not allowed from this network or at this time.
access.login_ban.settings_invalid: The login auto-ban settings are invalid; check {key} in the system settings.
access.login_ban.banned: Too many failed sign-ins; this IP is temporarily banned. Try again in {retryAfter} seconds.
login_bans.list.description: The login auto-ban settings in effect and the addresses banned right now (platform only). Requires access.login-bans.read.
login_bans.lift.description: Lift the ban on an address together with its failure count in the current window (platform only). Requires access.login-bans.lift.
access.constraint.code_invalid: A constraint rule code must not be empty or contain whitespace: {code}
access.constraint.target_mismatch: {type} rules cannot target {targetType}: separation of duty and condition rules target roles, mutual exclusion targets permissions, cardinality targets roles or users.
access.constraint.items_too_few: This kind of rule needs at least {min} items.
access.constraint.target_invalid: Rule item target {target} is not on this side or not usable (roles must be enabled, permissions must be in the catalog, users must belong to this side).
access.constraint.conditions_required: A condition rule needs at least one condition, and at most {maxGroups} condition groups and {maxConditions} conditions.
access.activation.not_held: Role {id} is not held right now and cannot be activated.
access.constraint.violated: Constraint rule "{name}" ({code}) is violated; the change was not made.
access.session_role.not_found: Session role record {id} does not exist.
constraint_rules.list.description: List the constraint rules of the current side, by evaluation order by default. Requires access.constraint-rules.read.
constraint_rules.get.description: Get a constraint rule by ID. Requires access.constraint-rules.read.
constraint_rules.create.description: Create a constraint rule. Requires access.constraint-rules.create.
constraint_rules.update.description: Replace a constraint rule, including its status and items. Requires access.constraint-rules.update.
constraint_rules.set_status.description: Enable or disable a constraint rule. Requires access.constraint-rules.update.
constraint_rules.delete.description: Delete constraint rules together with their items. Requires access.constraint-rules.delete.
session_roles.list.description: List the roles each session of the current side has activated. Requires access.session-roles.read.
session_roles.get.description: Get one session role record by ID. Requires access.session-roles.read.
auth.session_roles.description: The roles the current session holds right now and which of them are activated. Requires signing in only.
